hero.headline: Empower Classrooms with Clean Water & Health Essentials
hero.subheadline: EduDrop connects donors and alumni directly with partner school bursars to supply pure water cases, dispensers, sanitizers, and paper supplies with 100% transparency.
hero.highlightText: Help stock classrooms for the upcoming semester

whyEduDrop.heading: Driven by Wellness, Built on Total Transparency
whyEduDrop.leadStatement: Your donation never disappears into overhead. Every single dollar becomes physical supplies delivered directly to the school gate.
whyEduDrop.body: School bursars publish their exact monthly requirements for pure spring water, classroom dispensers, sanitizers, and paper supplies. Donors select a verified campus, choose the quantity to sponsor, and our team consolidates and delivers every case directly into classroom hands.

howItWorks.title: Choose a Verified School
howItWorks.description: Pick your alma mater or a partner school in your local area and inspect their bursar's active classroom supply requests.

howItWorks.title: Sponsor Water & Essentials
howItWorks.description: Choose the exact items and quantities to sponsor—from spring water cases to classroom dispensers—with a one-time or monthly gift.

howItWorks.title: Direct Campus Delivery
howItWorks.description: EduDrop consolidates all community orders and delivers directly to the school bursar on scheduled monthly delivery dates with full photo confirmation.

testimonials.reviewText: EduDrop took the guesswork out of giving. Knowing our alumni donations turn into physical water cases delivered straight to the bursar gives our members complete peace of mind.
Our classrooms used to struggle with basic water dispenser refills. Now, monthly deliveries arrive like clockwork, fully funded by community sponsors.
The bursar dashboard and real-time school needs list took the guesswork out of giving. Our students now have fresh hydration stations in every hallway.
